finite_grid.arithmetic: exact integers and rational Gaussian elimination
finite_grid.simple_graphs: all connected labelled simple graphs on one through five vertices
finite_grid.stack_graphs: all connected labelled simple graphs on one through four vertices and all roots

model.conductances: one positive conductance c_e per labelled edge
model.edge_orientation: one frozen arbitrary orientation per labelled undirected edge
model.graph: finite connected loopless undirected multigraph with distinctly labelled parallel edges
model.laplacian: L=B diag(c) B^T for incidence columns b_e=delta_tail-delta_head
model.legal_update: pop every visible card on any currently visible directed cycle
model.root: one arbitrary vertex r; root has no stack
model.stack_law: independent infinite outgoing-edge stacks with probability c_e/c(v)
model.transfer_current: H_ef=c_f b_e^T L^+ b_f; principal minors equal the symmetric sqrt(c) kernel minors
model.wilson_rule: fixed increasing vertex order with chronological loop erasure

theorem_contract.abelian: if one legal cycle-pop sequence terminates then every legal order terminates with identical pop counts and terminal tree
theorem_contract.boundaries: singleton, already-a-tree, parallel-edge, and root-change cases are included
theorem_contract.lerw: the canonical legal pop order is Wilson chronological loop-erased random walk for every vertex order
theorem_contract.matrix_tree: Z_c=det L^(r) for every root r
theorem_contract.termination: for independent infinite stacks every legal cycle-pop order terminates almost surely
theorem_contract.transfer_current: Pr(e_1,...,e_k in T)=det(H_{e_i,e_j}) for distinct labelled edges
theorem_contract.tree_law: Pr(T)=product_{e in T} c_e/Z_c for every labelled spanning tree
